title: Manual Upload Test
speaker: Test Run
blurb:
This sermon uses a refreshingly honest gym analogy to get at something most of us quietly know but rarely say out loud: showing up is not the same as growing. The speaker draws a straight line between sitting beside the equipment and sitting in a church service, suggesting that proximity to good things does not automatically produce change in a person.

The core challenge here is about spiritual maturity, and the point is simple but worth sitting with. Maturity is not something that happens to you over time just because you keep attending. It is built, deliberately and actively, through actually engaging with your faith rather than observing it from a comfortable distance.

There is no heavy theological framework here, just a direct and good-humoured nudge toward honest self-reflection. If you have been showing up to church, or even just watching online, without really putting anything into it, this is a message worth hearing.

Come and join us on a Sunday at Harvest Church and be part of a community that is actually working it out together.
